candidates.title: Title-Case-phrase PERSON_NAME FP suppression stack (field-label position veto + common-word filter + evidence requirement)
candidates.expected_impact: Single largest precision lever, present in 5/5 datasets: 369 (ai4p, ~40% of strict FPs) + 5,906 (nemotron, 71% of all FPs) + 8,270 (gretel, 71% of all FPs) + 680 (TAB) + 364 (home) = ~15,589 vanilla strict FPs, plus ~965 adjacent ORG-heading FPs (gretel 637 industry-noun headings, nemotron 328 org-on-headers) if the same heading/label-position veto is shared. Home benefits directly (364 of its 1,019 FPs are this class).
candidates.implementation_sketch: Three stacked suppressors in the capitalized-run PERSON recognizers: (a) field-label position veto — reject a Title-Case phrase immediately followed by ':' or '|', or wrapped in markdown '**'/heading markers (pairs with candidate 11's structure pass, or cheap local char checks); (b) common-English-word filter — reject when ALL tokens sit in a corpus-frequency list (derivable from public prose or upstream TRAIN splits, never test gold); (c) start-of-run stopword/determiner/role-noun guard ('The Court', 'On', 'United States District') + require a given-name-lexicon or honorific evidence token for context-free bare bigrams. Share the heading/list-position veto with the ORGANIZATION industry-noun pattern.
candidates.risk: This is a masking-path suppressor, so the failure direction is under-masking real names that happen to be common words ('Summer Rose'); mitigate by requiring label-position OR all-tokens-common rather than either alone, and keep the given-name-lexicon override. Gate on the home floor: home R must stay >= 0.9022 (expected net home gain since 364 home FPs are this class and home gold names are conventional). Not an eval-time-only drop — intrinsic detector precision rule, sp2 leak-direction rule satisfied but the residual under-mask risk must be documented in the assurance report.

candidates.title: Per-(engine,type) single-engine acceptance in swarm fusion (replace the blanket SEMANTIC_TYPES corroboration gate)
candidates.expected_impact: Largest measured recall headroom in the program: TAB union counterfactual regex∪gliner∪presidio lifts relaxed R 0.091→0.582 and F2 ≈0.10→≈0.55 (7,160 gold); ai4privacy gliner pre-fusion matches 597/1436 gold but only 298 survive (≈300 reachable spans thrown away); gretel prose probe loses 152/780 gliner-matched gold post-fusion (street_address-dominant — attacks the 726-span largest gretel FN class); nemotron probe discards 26 IoU-1.0 gold hits per 30 records; home discards 30 incl. conf 0.93–0.95 findings.
candidates.implementation_sketch: In src/pii_anon/swarm.py Layer 4: replace the blanket SEMANTIC_TYPES corroboration gate (corroboration_min=2 / meta>=0.85, structurally unreachable because the logistic fallback caps single-engine non-regex meta_score at sigmoid(2*ds_conf-1.5)<=0.62) with per-(engine,type) acceptance priors: admit single-engine gliner PERSON_NAME/STREET_ADDRESS/DATE_OF_BIRTH/USERNAME/PHONE above per-type confidence thresholds derived from dev/TRAIN alone-precision (gliner PERSON alone-P 0.911 TAB / 0.393 ai4p); keep gating gliner-only PASSWORD (alone-P 0.10, 302 preds/30 hits). Add post-fusion plausibility gates for admitted ML findings: word-boundary span starts (fixes mid-word 'Col<<leen Redding>>'), calendar-valid dates (fixes DATE_TIME on '1526-32-18-49'), alphabetic-word requirement for LOC-typed findings (fixes 46 home LOC-on-base64/EIN FPs). Keep FloorProjectingFusion untouched.
candidates.risk: Precision crater if acceptance is blanket rather than per-(engine,type) — the ai4privacy PASSWORD evidence is the cautionary case. Floor invariant holds by construction (FloorProjectingFusion still re-injects the regex floor, so swarm >= vanilla). Direction is additive recall = safe over-masking on the production path (no sp2 leak-direction concern). Thresholds must be tuned on dev/TRAIN splits only. Home gate re-run mandatory (home swarm already carries +67 FPs; the plausibility gates should net-reduce them).

candidates.title: Labeled-field value extractor: shared tolerant cue-to-value bridge + label-wins type arbitration + cue-capture hygiene
candidates.expected_impact: ~2,570 FNs + ~500 FPs across 5/5 datasets from one shared component: nemotron 614 adjacency-broken + 701 cue/value-class-narrow + 111 DOB-cue = 1,426; ai4p 121 bare-numeric-after-label + labeled-card/date subsets ≈ 200; gretel 218 keyword-gated ID types; TAB 328 docket 'no. NNNNN/YY' + 149 'born in YYYY'; home ≈250 (encoded-in-labeled-field 63, DOB-cue 38, config credentials 23, income 33, phone-over-labeled-account 68, tax-id arbitration 27). FP side: nemotron 192 cue-captures-label-word, gretel 124 + ai4p 39 + home 9 username common-word grabs.
candidates.implementation_sketch: One shared cue→value bridge used by ALL cue-gated patterns: tolerate inline markdown ('**','__'), copula/preposition tokens (is|was|of), appositive commas, XML tags, quotes, and config key:value forms between cue and value; enforce word boundary after the cue token (kills 'Patient Id<<entification>>'); widen value classes behind a strong cue to generic alphanumeric-with-dashes with dictionary-word veto and digit-required shapes for id types; field-label lexicon → entity type with 'label wins' arbitration over bare-format readings (fixes phone-over-account, tax-id-as-national-id, passport-context bare-9-digit, and types base64/percent-decoded values from the label not the shape). Cue-synonym inventories derived from upstream TRAIN splits (nemotron TRAIN must be downloaded — only the test parquet is local) and public field-name vocabularies, never test gold or generator templates.
candidates.risk: Additive recall = safe leak direction; type-override changes labels, not coverage, so masking is preserved either way. Precision bounded by the keyword gate; the hygiene half (word boundaries, value-shape vetoes) is a masking-path suppressor and needs the home floor check. Anti-template guard: cue lexicons from TRAIN/public sources only.

candidates.title: Adapter label plumbing: PresidioAdapter native-label normalization + GLiNERAdapter label-set extension (organization, location/city, occupation)
candidates.expected_impact: Cheapest change with the widest reach: presidio solo already scores TAB relaxed R=0.530 (DATETIME 0.918 → attacks the 2,240-span prose-date class; LOC 0.678 → 487 toponyms; PERSON 0.692; NRP 0.234 → 501 demographics) and ZERO of it survives because its labels never normalize; gliner emits zero city/location findings on ai4p (119-span class) and zero organization findings anywhere (gretel 594 + TAB 421+526 + nemotron 294 + home 95 org FNs have no ML channel at all). With both engines emitting ORG/LOC, cross-engine corroboration (count>=2) passes even under today's gate — standalone value before candidate 2 lands.
candidates.implementation_sketch: PresidioAdapter: add a native-label normalization map (PERSON→PERSON_NAME, LOCATION→LOCATION, DATE_TIME→DATE_TIME, NRP→NATIONALITY, ORG→ORGANIZATION) so presidio findings key into PRED_MAP, corroborate gliner instead of splitting the type vote, and survive emission. GLiNERAdapter (src/pii_anon/engines/gliner_adapter.py): add 'organization'/'company', 'location'/'city', and 'occupation' to _PII_LABELS + _LABEL_MAP — config-level edits. While in the adapter, verify the window-offset anchoring bug evidenced by the mid-word 'Col<<leen Redding>>' span (tests/test_gliner_windowing_sp4.py seam).
candidates.risk: More ML findings entering fusion grows the FP surface wherever fusion admits them — measure per-type and sequence before candidate 2's acceptance-policy change. Home floor invariant unaffected (purely additive channel; floor projection intact). No leak-direction concern (additive).

candidates.title: Natural-language + locale date grammar and DOB-cue promotion
candidates.expected_impact: ~2,670 FNs across 5/5: TAB 2,240 prose dates (79-82% of ALL its DATETIME gold) + 149 'born in YYYY'; gretel 74 day-first/legal/tz forms; ai4p 59 ordinal/textual DOBs; nemotron 111 DOB-behind-markdown; home 38 cue-adjacent ISO DOBs. Also converts nemotron's 158 date-on-date_of_birth FPs into TPs.
candidates.implementation_sketch: Add a month-name date family to DATE_TIME/DATE: day-Month-year ('27 May 1994'), Month-year, 'Month d, yyyy', ordinal 'Nth of Month' and legal '1st day of January, 2023', date ranges, and 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss TZ'. DOB-cue window promotion: re-type DATE_ISO/DATE_TIME to DATE_OF_BIRTH when a birth cue ('born', 'DOB', 'date of birth') is within ~30 chars or the value sits in a DOB-labeled field (rides candidate 3's bridge for markdown-broken cues); uncued dates keep the existing honest drop.
candidates.risk: Low: promotion is strictly cue-gated so the ambiguous-date honest-projection discipline stays. Boundary lesson from gretel's presidio evidence — strip leading stopwords/determiners from date spans ('no later than March 20, 2023') to avoid manufacturing FP+FN pairs. No leak-direction issue (additive).

Abrahamson') + 81 rank+initial + 145 prose names (28 diacritic, 5 all-caps) + ~731 boundary-echo FPs; gretel 483 name-shape (87 non-ASCII, 52 ALL-CAPS, 15 hyphenated, 136 single-token); nemotron 468 single-token labeled/appositive names; ai4p 78 salutation-absorbed FPs + share of 207 rare-name FNs; home 150 bare coreferent mentions + 50 FN/64 FP boundary absorption.

candidates.title: Numeric-identifier guard and validator bundle (GPS plausibility, left-prefix guard, bare-9-digit gating, IMEI/Amex, IBAN mod-97, BIC country check, honeypot demotion)
candidates.expected_impact: ~2,050 FPs across 5/5, each guard spec-derivable: GPS-family 1,095 (nemotron 377 on dd/mm-and-ratings, gretel 662 on money amounts at P=0.013, TAB 36 on article numbers, home 20 on slash-dates over DOB gold); document-serial-as-phone 76; IMEI-as-card 56; bare-9-digit SSN ~300 (ai4p 43 + gretel 187 + nemotron customer-ids); digit-run-inside-larger-identifier 231; digit cross-label 71; IBAN 21 + SWIFT_BIC 19; 9 home honeypots.
candidates.implementation_sketch: GPS: require >=3 decimal places on both components OR a coordinate cue/hemisphere/degree marker; drop '/' as a separator; reject currency-prefixed and date-embedded candidates; add the hemisphere-suffixed format ('40.7234 N, 123.1235 W') the FN side needs. Left-boundary guard: reject numeric candidates glued to '[A-Z]{2,}-' prefixes or whose leading group parses as 20YY MM. candidates.title: Organization/institution capability: contextual cue grammar + person/place/org family arbitration
candidates.expected_impact: ~1,930 FNs (gretel 594 suffixless/ALL-CAPS orgs, TAB 421 unmodeled institutions + 526 institutions eaten by the person heuristic, nemotron 294, home 95) plus ~760 FPs from the same mechanism's FP face (TAB 667 institution-as-person, ai4p 95 family confusion) — one arbitration fix credits both ledger lines. candidates.implementation_sketch: Institution-keyword arbitration in the existing eval_cross_type_arbitration seam: a capitalized run containing Court/Ministry/Board/Commission/Directorate/University/Hospital/Agency demotes PERSON_NAME and emits ORGANIZATION. Employment/party/provider cue grammar: 'at/against/v./Provider:/Employer:/CARRIER:/Issued by:' governs the org reading of a capitalized phrase and outranks person. Over-demotion could cost person recall on institution-word surnames ('Bank', 'Church'); keep the keyword list institutional and require the keyword to head or tail the phrase. Cross-dataset regression on all 5 plus home gate before accepting.

candidates.title: Address grammar rework: evidence-gated open grammar (suffixless recall + year-guard precision)

candidates.title: Layer-3 calibration re-fit with per-(engine,type) reliability features (prose-domain coverage)
candidates.expected_impact: Trained-path alternative/complement to candidate 2, addressing the same measured discard mass: the logistic fallback caps single-engine non-regex meta_score at sigmoid(2*ds_conf-1.5)<=0.62 (below the 0.85 override), and the trained ds_params/temperature/informativeness in ~/.pii_anon/swarm push prose-engine scores under the 0.50 emission threshold — so even a 0.95-confidence gliner finding dies. Reachable mass identical to candidate 2's counterfactuals (TAB F2 ≈0.10→≈0.55 union bound).
candidates.implementation_sketch: Re-fit the DS/calibration parameters on a prose-heavy dev mixture (dev/TRAIN splits only) with per-(engine,type) reliability features so calibrated confidence, not a hand threshold, decides single-engine emission; add engine-alone-precision priors as model features. Only pursue if candidate 2's policy-level priors prove too coarse in Phase-B measurement.
candidates.risk: Recorded precedent says meta-learner training was NOT worth it (floor-locked to core) — the mined evidence changes the question (calibration is now the identified discard mechanism), but sequencing discipline applies: policy fix (candidate 2) first, retrain second. Training data must be dev/TRAIN only (leak rule); floor invariant re-verified and the full home gate + adversarial-close re-run after any producer-path calibration change.

synthesis.swarm_channel_evidence: Every miner independently measured the same channel loss: pool engines find gold that fusion then discards, on all five datasets. ai4privacy-400k: GLiNER pre-fusion relaxed-matches 597/1436 gold spans (1,520 mapped preds; alone P=0.393/R=0.416) but only 298 survive SwarmFusionStrategy — per-label hit_pre→survived: GIVENNAME 150→63, TELEPHONENUM 74→42, DATEOFBIRTH 44→9, STREET 40→7, USERNAME 43→9, PASSWORD 30→4, CREDITCARDNUMBER 24→11, IDCARDNUM 15→0, DRIVERLICENSENUM 16→5; gliner ALONE dominates the fused swarm on both precision and recall on this prose set. Nemotron (30-record probe): 69/124 gliner findings (56%) absent from the fused output, 26 of the discarded spans hitting reachable gold at IoU 1.0 — labeled passwords ('**Temporary Password:** b9M!k7Lp#5nXz3'), usernames (zakaria.ramos), born-on DOBs, single-token first names — precisely the top regex FN classes. Gretel (150-record prose probe, 780 gold): 152 gold spans gliner matched were LOST post-fusion (sampled 60: street_address 44, name 13), sitting directly on the largest gretel FN class (726 suffixless addresses); gliner's surviving contribution is boundary precision (strict name +691 tp full-split). TAB/ECHR (all 127 judgments): fusion discards 442/892 (49.6%) of gliner's gold-matching PERSON findings despite gliner alone P=0.911 (PERSON relaxed R 0.755 vs pipeline 0.447); presidio solo reaches relaxed R=0.530 (DATETIME 0.918, LOC 0.678, PERSON 0.692, NRP 0.234) and ZERO survives — verified on doc 0 that 63 presidio + 5 gliner findings in yields a fused output of exactly the 29 regex findings; union counterfactual regex∪gliner∪presidio: relaxed R 0.091→0.582, P 0.171→0.452, F2 ≈0.10→≈0.55. HOME: 30 gold spans raw gliner finds are absent post-fusion, including conf 0.95 ('Johann Sebastian von Hohenberg') and conf 0.93 (ISO DOB) — confidence alone cannot clear the gate. Mechanism, located in src/pii_anon/swarm.py Layers 3-4: (a) the SEMANTIC_TYPES corroboration gate (corroboration_min=2, meta>=0.85 override) is structurally unreachable for single-engine non-regex candidates because the logistic fallback caps meta_score at sigmoid(2*ds_conf-1.5)<=0.62; (b) emission_threshold=0.50 kills most single-engine non-semantic candidates (IDCARDNUM 15→0); (c) Layer-3 trained calibration (~/.pii_anon/swarm ds_params/temperature/informativeness) pushes prose-engine scores under threshold; (d) PresidioAdapter emits PERSON/LOCATION/DATE_TIME/NRP verbatim with no native-label normalization, so presidio both splits the type vote and cannot corroborate gliner; (e) FloorProjectingFusion re-injects only regex spans, locking the swarm to the regex floor on prose; (f) GLiNERAdapter._PII_LABELS carries no location/city, organization, or occupation label, so entire gold families (ai4p CITY, gretel/TAB/nemotron ORG, nemotron occupation/demographics) have zero ML channel regardless of fusion. Alone-precision priors for Phase-B threshold design: gliner PERSON 0.911 (TAB) vs 0.393 (ai4p overall); gliner PASSWORD 0.10 (302 preds/30 hits — must stay gated). Where ML findings DO pass, the measured FP cost is boundary/plausibility, not existence: gretel +364 (gliner name fragments at hyphen/initial boundaries, presidio date phrase-extents), nemotron +42 (DATE_TIME on malformed ids like '1526-32-18-49'; mid-word-anchored 'Col<<leen Redding>>' — a window-offset anchoring bug to check in gliner_adapter.py), home +67 (46 NER LOC labels on base64/EIN opaque fragments). Phase-B should therefore combine per-(engine,type) single-engine acceptance priors + presidio label normalization + gliner label-set extension + post-fusion plausibility/boundary gates (word-boundary span starts, calendar-valid dates, alphabetic-word requirement for LOC), with FloorProjectingFusion untouched so the home floor invariant holds by construction. TAB probe artifacts: scratchpad mine_tab.py / engine_probe.py / gliner_discarded.json under /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-subhashholla-Development-pii-anonymize-pseudonymize-pii-anon-core-pii-anon-code/a02504b7-c72d-487f-bb5b-7d1686e50fcc/scratchpad/.
